items.name: theme
items.title: Co Ventures theme
items.description: Brand, semantic and Tailwind-theme tokens plus base styles. Drops app/coventures.css into the project; @import it from globals.css after tailwindcss.
items.docs: Add `@import "./coventures.css";` to app/globals.css after `@import "tailwindcss";`, then delete any :root / @theme colour blocks it replaces. Load Ovo and Work Sans via next/font with variable names --font-ovo and --font-work-sans (see README).

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Pill button. default = solid ink; outline = thin ink border that tints on hover, never inverts.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Small-radius uppercase tracked label. peach / lavender / lime are the brand tones.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: Short aside on a pastel block: peach = attention, lavender = context, lime = good news, default = neutral. Optional icon and title. Not for errors.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: Title block every page starts with: eyebrow, h1 (Ovo via the base layer), description, right-aligned actions.

items.name: stat-card
items.title: StatCard
items.description: KPI tile: label, value, delta pill, hint, footer slot, optional link. Uses next/link.

items.name: states
items.title: States
items.description: LoadingState, SkeletonRows, EmptyState and ErrorState: the four states every data view needs.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: StatusBadge
items.description: Status word to brand tone in one place (syndicate stages, ask status, edit actions, health).

items.name: skill
items.title: Agent skill
items.description: Drops the coventures-design skill into .claude/skills so Claude Code and Co-Work agents style the project correctly.

items.name: kit
items.title: Full kit
items.description: Theme, all components and the agent skill in one install.
